sdist_entries.description: Required entries are these paths plus lanes.dist_safe.helpers and every module under lanes.dist_safe.discover. Forbidden entries are lanes.checkout_only.modules. The verifier reads this contract so MANIFEST.in and this file are the only places a lane asset is declared.

dist_safe.description: Runs after pip install dist/*.whl from a directory that cannot import checkout src/. Tests load only packaged or generated assets.

checkout_only.description: Developer checkout lane. Requires scripts/, .github/, packages/, deploy/, and checkout-only fixtures. Compatibility and quality CI continue to run this broader suite.

import_guard.armed: Armed by default, with no arming variable. REVIEWSENSEI_ALLOW_CHECKOUT_IMPORT=1 is the only opt-out. The checkout lane is separated by test discovery rather than by disarming: unittest discover skips the non-package lane directories and tests/conftest.py makes pytest match it.
import_guard.rule: review_sensei.__file__ must resolve under sys.prefix. When REVIEWSENSEI_CHECKOUT_ROOT is set it adds a second rule, that the package must not resolve under that checkout's src/, and the variable must name a directory containing src/ so misconfiguration fails closed.
import_guard.lane_marker: REVIEWSENSEI_DIST_SAFE_LANE=1 marks the suite as the packaged one extracted from the sdist. It no longer arms the guard and is used only to assert checkout-only modules are absent.

reproduction.command: python -m build --outdir dist && python -m venv /tmp/rs-sdist-venv && /tmp/rs-sdist-venv/bin/python -m pip install dist/review_sensei-0.1.1.tar.gz && tar -xzf dist/review_sensei-0.1.1.tar.gz && cd review_sensei-0.1.1 && python -I -m unittest discover -s tests -v
reproduction.result: Loader and fixture errors in seven broader modules were caused by unavailable helpers/fixtures (scripts/, deploy/, tests/fake_github_http.py, tests/fixtures), not engine assertion failures.
